notes.title: Online play arrives in another classic game title!
notes.content:
Roll the dice and take on the world! Online Duels can now be enjoyed in Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Dice Monsters as part of the Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION!

With this update, there are now three classic titles capable of playing online with Duelists from around the world.Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION games with online play support: - Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters 4: Battle of Great Duelists- Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004- Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Dice Monsters

Download and install this free update before booting up the game to enjoy online play for all three of these titles.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update – Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004
notes.content:
As part of patch 1.2.0 you’ll be able to take your retro gaming to new heights as you challenge players from across the world and prove you are truly a Dueling world champion in Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004! 

Now you can Duel online in two of the titles available in Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION;
 Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters 4: Battle of Great Duelists and Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004.  

Be sure to download and install this free update before booting up the game to enjoy the additional online play.

notes.title: "Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION" is available now!
notes.content:

"Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION" containing 14 pieces of Yu-Gi-Oh! video game history is now available!
